m-401.translation: Stay up late binge-watching if you want, eat hot pot whenever you feel like it—no reporting in, no one checking up on you, and your whole paycheck goes to yourself. Isn't that great?

errors.note: 原文“不快乐吗？”是反问，强调“这样很快乐”，译成“Isn't that great?”语气偏弱且略偏离原句的“快乐”语义，可更贴近“Isn't that a happy life?”之类。

m-405.translation: A friend recommended this hilarious variety show.

m-404.translation: Hey guys watching this, do you think I snuck a bite of the dragon fruit?

m-406.translation: The boss just sent out some bizarre notice.

errors.note: “notice”是可数名词，单数泛指应用“a bizarre notice”或复数“some bizarre notices”，此处搭配不当。

m-407.translation: I just started at a new company and noticed all my coworkers go to lunch together, but I'm pretty introverted—how do I naturally fit in with them?

m-408.translation: Come on, please, just let me borrow it for a day.

m-410.translation: You must be starving. Was it just cooked?

m-409.translation: So what? They're all little animals—what's the difference?

m-411.translation: Hurry up, Jiujiu, or I'm telling your husband.

errors.note: “九九”是“赶紧”的谐音/催促语，不是人名，译成 Jiujiu 会被观众误认为人名。
原文“不然就是你老公”意为“否则（来接你的）就是你老公”，译文增译成“我就告诉你老公”，意思发生明显偏差。

m-414.translation: My clothes are soaked with sweat after that workout.

m-413.translation: No one could've done worse than me on this exam, right?

m-418.translation: I'm begging you, hahaha, don't check my homework!

m-417.translation: I've decided to start my diet tomorrow.

m-416.translation: You sold all my game gear, didn't you?

m-419.translation: Kid's dad: What do I do? I want to laugh too.

m-412.translation: Actually, it's not that low. In places like Mu Ling and Niu Zihan, where there are tons of trolls, lots of people spam "you're triggered and crying" — it's practically the standard go-to.

errors.note: 人名音译不统一/不规范，Mu Ling 与 Niu Zihan 混用拼音风格，且“木灵”作为网名可能应保留原形或统一处理。

errors.span: where there are tons of trolls
errors.note: “串子”指故意引战/钓鱼的人，译作 trolls 基本可接受，但“多的地方”被处理成定语从句，语义重心略有偏移。
“你已急哭”是固定梗式表达，译文拆成“triggered and crying”略增译且语气不如原文凝练，但意思基本保留。
“标配”译成 standard go-to 稍显生硬，口语字幕中可更自然，但不影响理解。

m-421.translation: No way—can you share some of that luck with me?

errors.note: “不处”是网络口语，意为“不处对象/不谈恋爱”，译成“No way”改变了意思，变成表示惊讶或拒绝。

m-423.translation: What on earth does "cabbage smiling at me" even mean?

m-422.translation: I thought this meme was always a classic—I'm used to using it in everyday chats.

errors.note: 原文句末语气词“啊”未译出，语气略有减弱，但不影响理解。

m-420.translation: He's up in the sky, staring down at you all like a total idiot—exactly the same.

errors.note: “失禁”意为大小便失禁，译文误译为“like a total idiot”，完全曲解原意。

errors.span: staring down at you all like a total idiot
errors.note: 原文“失禁的看着你们”被误译成“像白痴一样盯着你们”，丢失了“失禁”这一核心含义。

m-426.translation: I just leave you on read.

m-425.translation: I'm already picturing you drinking water with it—you'll definitely be the coolest one in the office!

m-424.translation: The Qing Dynasty's been gone for ages, and you're still pulling this workplace oppression crap?

m-427.translation: I highly recommend you give it a listen.

m-430.translation: My blind date suddenly went quiet.

m-429.translation: What the hell are you filming?

m-433.translation: Just saw the most epic new meme.

m-431.translation: The lady who runs this shop let me in on her secret recipe.

m-428.translation: Sunshine boy Huang Buliqiu teaches everyone how to use the new meme "Who Cares About You".

errors.note: “黄不溜秋”是描述肤色偏黄的绰号，音译成 Huang Buliqiu 会让英文观众无法理解其含义，宜意译或加注。
“谁理你”更接近“Who cares about you”的口语否定语气，但作为梗名直译尚可；不过原文“新梗”指网络流行语，译文用 meme 基本对应，此处仅语气略生硬。

m-432.translation: I just saw a few new places opened up nearby—hot pot, BBQ, crayfish, they've got it all. I'm so torn.

m-435.translation: That's such a classic move. My ex brushed me off the same way—even for important questions, they'd just reply with an emoji.

m-434.translation: Why is everyone online saying 'sure sure' all the time now?

errors.note: “可以可以”是表示认可、同意的口语重复，译成“sure sure”改变了语义，应为“okay okay”或“can can”之类更贴近原意的表达。
原文“网上这么多人都爱说”指网上很多人，译文“everyone online”过度概括为所有网上的人，略有增译。

m-437.translation: Why are you watching videos of hot guys again?

m-439.translation: Running into your boss in the elevator and not knowing whether or not to say hi.

m-440.translation: I want to start a new series but I don't know what to do it on.

m-436.translation: No, that's not the right way to do it.

errors.note: “不处”是网络口语，意为“不行/算了/不干”，译文译成“No”尚可，但原文“不处”被当作“不”处理，漏掉了“处”的语义，且“不处”整体含义未准确传达。

errors.span: that's not the right way to do it
errors.note: “不地道”指做法不正宗/不地道/不合规矩，译文译为“不是正确的做法”，语义有偏差，丢失了“不地道”的语感。

errors.span: No, that's not the right way to do it.
errors.note: 译文偏书面、生硬，不像字幕口语，原文是口语化表达。

m-441.translation: The two cities are a 2-hour direct ride apart on the high-speed rail. Remember to book a guesthouse in the old town in advance, and bring sunscreen and moisturizer.

m-438.translation: Coach says you need to get yourself ready before the match.

errors.note: 原文“自己调整状态”是教练对说话对象（或泛指）的要求，译文用“you need to”把主语明确为“你”，且“need to”语气比原文的“自己调整”更强，属于增译/语气偏移。
“调整状态”指调节竞技/心理状态，译为“get yourself ready”偏“做好准备”，语义略有窄化，但大意可通。

m-443.translation: How should I reply to this?

m-442.translation: 666, and there's a second level—nostalgia overload!

errors.note: “爷青回”是网络用语，意为“我的青春回来了”，译文用“nostalgia overload”改成了“怀旧感爆棚”，丢失了“青春回归”这一核心含义。

m-444.translation: Say one more word and I'm gonna lose it.

m-446.translation: My roommate games in the middle of the night and the clacking keyboard keeps me awake.

m-449.translation: The person I secretly have a crush on got together with someone else.

m-445.translation: You're already crying from the stress—if you don't buy it soon, I'm really gonna cry.

errors.note: “急哭”是夸张说法，指急得快要哭出来，译文却译成“因压力而哭”，把夸张的催促语气变成了对观众情绪状态的陈述，意思出现偏差。

errors.span: You're already crying from the stress
errors.note: 原文是直播带货式的夸张口语调侃，译文偏书面、解释性，不够像字幕口语。

m-448.translation: It's best to pick one that includes in-home installation, so the elderly don't have to deal with the hassle themselves.

m-447.translation: You could call him a clean freak—but he dries his socks and wears them again. You could say he's a slob—but hey, at least he dries them before wearing them again.

errors.note: “爱干净”只是讲卫生，译成“clean freak”（洁癖）语义过重，改变了原意。
“不爱干净”不等于“slob”（邋遢鬼），程度和贬义都被夸大。
添加的口语填充词改变了原文对称、克制的调侃语气。

m-453.translation: At the same time, develop your own interests and hobbies, and don't rely on the other person too much.

m-452.translation: I really don't have time to mess around with you. It's totally normal for a girl to spend half an hour on makeup, okay?

m-450.translation: Take it seriously—I've written it down in my little book.

m-454.translation: There are only 3 people watching the stream.

m-451.translation: "So What? Who Cares?" — only when you read it as one phrase does it become a real meme. Who else gets it?

errors.note: “谁懂”是网络用语，意为“谁能理解/有共鸣”，译文增译成“Who else gets it?”（还有谁懂），改变了原意并添加了原文没有的“还有别人”含义。

errors.span: only when you read it as one phrase does it become a real meme
errors.note: “连起来”指把两部分连读成一个整体，译文用“read it as one phrase”偏书面生硬，且“read”不如“put it together/say it together”贴合口语字幕语气。

m-457.translation: The boss said we have to work overtime for a whole month straight.

m-456.translation: We're pulling an all-nighter tonight—no arguments.

m-455.translation: Lately I've noticed that the music I like is getting overused by short videos again.

m-459.translation: You can split up the time—like 10 minutes in the morning and 10 minutes in the evening.

m-461.translation: How would you describe a streamer who openly hits up a big spender for gifts?

m-458.translation: Bro, it's the final exam tomorrow and you won't even let me copy off you?

m-460.translation: Back in my day, I was full of fire too—my moves were so slick, I was a force to be reckoned with.

errors.note: “一手操作”指亲自操作/一手操办，译文“my moves”只保留了动作，弱化了“亲自、一手”的含义，但整体意思基本传达。

errors.span: 打的那叫一个八面威风
errors.note: “八面威风”形容气势逼人、威风凛凛，译文“a force to be reckoned with”偏向“不可小觑”，气势感略有减弱，但可接受。

m-462.translation: I can't even—this meme is so unhinged, I'm laughing so hard my stomach hurts.

m-463.translation: You think shitposting is easy? You have to get up at five every morning to memorize memes.

m-467.translation: I can't take this. This is way too embarrassing.

m-465.translation: You should've said so earlier! I just styled my hair and now my pillow's covered in snowflakes.

m-468.translation: We agreed to save money together, but you shop till you drop every day.

m-469.translation: Remember, you're there to celebrate the couple—looking presentable and appropriate is what matters most.

m-466.translation: The blogger does a bit on the 'I wanna check the cards' meme.

errors.note: “does a bit on”略显生硬，字幕口语中更自然的是“does the 'I wanna check the cards' meme”或“acts out the meme”。
“The blogger”偏正式、书面，字幕口语中通常用“This blogger”或“The vlogger”。

m-471.translation: My roommate secretly watches funny videos under the covers at night, trying not to laugh out loud.

m-472.translation: The gameplay in this game is absolutely insane.

errors.note: “gameplay in this game”重复冗余，字幕中更自然的说法是“The gameplay”或“These controls”。
“秀”指操作精彩、令人印象深刻，而“insane”偏向疯狂/离谱，语气略有偏差。

m-470.translation: That's totally awesome — the kind that just can't be beat.

errors.note: “六百六十六”是网络用语，指“厉害/牛”，但译文丢掉了数字梗，也丢掉了“沉不下去”所对应的“666”双关（“666”在中文里也有“很溜”的意思），只译成了泛泛的“awesome”。

errors.span: the kind that just can't be beat
errors.note: 原文“沉不下去”是字面意思（浮起来/沉不下去），译文却译成“无法被超越”，意思发生了偏移。

m-473.translation: Especially those insane clutch comebacks—watching them makes my hands itch to hop into a match myself.

m-475.translation: I've been wanting to try baking at home lately, but I have zero experience. Any easy beginner-friendly recipes you'd recommend?

m-476.translation: Awesome—there's even a second level! This tribute is a spot-on recreation!

m-481.translation: Can you just say what you mean instead of beating around the bush?

m-478.translation: Oh man, why didn't you say so earlier? I thought I came up with that style myself!

m-477.translation: You can keep a mistake notebook to record typical problems and clever solution methods.

errors.note: 原文“发语音通话”指发起语音通话，译文用“calls me”未体现“语音通话”这一具体形式，略有信息缺失。

m-480.translation: My mom actually sent me a red packet on her own.

m-482.translation: No one is allowed to disturb you.

m-485.translation: My bestie's showing off her boyfriend on Moments again.

m-487.translation: I'm toast, aren't I? The cat's out of the bag now.

m-484.translation: My bestie says she dodged her blind date's rapid-fire questions by playing dumb.

m-488.translation: You can also set up an online study room with friends to keep each other accountable, or play white noise in the background to help you focus.

m-483.translation: You're basically their sugar daddy, hahaha—the whole class is counting on you to keep them alive.

errors.note: “活爹”是调侃某人像爹一样被全班依赖、供养，而“sugar daddy”特指包养关系中出钱的金主，带有性/金钱交易含义，语义明显偏离。
原文“养活”在此是口语夸张，指供养/接济全班，译成“keep them alive”字面化，略夸大了语义。

m-489.translation: After moving out, I found the room was even cleaner than when I was living in it.

m-486.translation: This year's Liaoning Spring Festival Gala has really stepped it up—the program lineup and stage design are now on par with the CCTV Gala.

m-490.translation: You're literally crying from stress—top student, hurry up and let me copy!

errors.note: 原文“已”表示“已经”，并非“字面上/真的”，literally 属于增译且语气偏移。

errors.span: top student, hurry up and let me copy!
errors.note: “学霸快借我抄抄”是口语化恳求语气，译文用命令式“hurry up and let me copy”显得生硬且语气不对。

m-491.translation: What exactly is tomorrow's exam even covering?

m-495.translation: Any easy beginner recipes you'd recommend?

m-494.translation: Take this seriously—tonight we're gonna devour all his snacks.

m-496.translation: Even begging has to get in line—there's 999+ more behind you.

m-493.translation: My mood: Like: I'm dying. Nervous: I'm dying. Happy: I'm dying. Help, I'm freaking out.

m-497.translation: Trying not to laugh in class, then getting called on by the teacher—and burping right as I answered.

m-499.translation: I'm done. I really can't do this anymore.

m-498.translation: My advisor just told us there's a group meeting tonight, out of nowhere.

m-492.translation: Lately lots of people online are saying '666, not even gonna salt anymore' — what's that about?

errors.note: “盐都不盐了”是网络谐音梗（“盐”谐音“言/演”等），直译为“不再撒盐”丢失了原意，观众无法理解这个梗的含义。
“六百六十六”在中文网络语境中表示“厉害/牛”，直接保留数字 666 尚可，但未加说明，英文观众可能不解其意。

m-500.translation: Usually after 2-3 weeks, once everyone gets to know you, they'll naturally accept you. For the first while, just be friendly and participate in moderation.

m-504.translation: Even if you want in, you have to get in line.

m-503.translation: My friend keeps saying he'll treat me to a meal, but every time he finds some excuse to back out.

m-501.translation: It's too real and too absurd.

errors.note: “抽象”在此处是网络口语，指内容离奇、难以理解或荒诞，译作“absurd”虽接近，但“too absurd”偏向“荒谬”，与“真实又抽象”的并列语气有偏差，未能准确传达“抽象”的特定含义。

m-506.translation: Douyin's been full of your memes lately—when are you gonna start making short videos?

m-505.translation: I've been working on this math problem for three hours and still can't solve it.

m-507.translation: The cafeteria lady's hand shakes like she's got Parkinson's when she serves the food.

m-508.translation: How do you say "suspecting the seer" in English when playing Werewolf?

m-512.translation: 3-4 times a week, 40 minutes each time.

m-510.translation: Damn, why didn't you tell me earlier? I was just about to go get in line.

m-514.translation: I just moved into a new place and want some low-maintenance plants—any recommendations?

m-509.translation: I'm telling you, that dancing bear is hilarious.

m-511.translation: I can't take this, I'm so embarrassed.

m-513.translation: I can't take it anymore—this plot is killing me.

m-522.translation: Why don't you go on a talent show?

m-518.translation: My ex-boyfriend actually ended up with my best friend.

m-517.translation: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? I've been waiting for this skin too!

m-515.translation: Maybe you're into abstract humor too. I showed some abstract memes to my roommates and they said they just don't get that kind of art. I'm dying.

errors.note: “搞抽象”是网络俚语，指荒诞/无厘头式幽默，译成“abstract humor”偏字面，但基本可理解。
原文“抽象视频”指荒诞/无厘头视频，译成“abstract memes”把视频窄化为梗图，略有偏差。
“笑死”是口语化反应，译成“I'm dying.”略显生硬，不够像字幕口语。

m-516.translation: I'm done—let me just lie down for a bit first.

m-521.translation: They went public three months ago—the whole internet knows. You're the only one still in the fan forum grinding out engagement numbers every day.

m-520.translation: My blind date suddenly put on their ex's favorite song.

errors.note: 原文“前任”未指明性别，但“their”与单数“blind date”搭配在此语境下指代不清，且“their ex”可能被理解为相亲对象自己的前任，而原文“前任”指相亲对象的前任，此处指代关系模糊，易造成误解。

m-523.translation: I'd recommend chartering a car for the whole trip or joining a small group tour—public transportation isn't very convenient.

m-527.translation: My boyfriend and I are always fighting over little things—like who does the dishes, or being late for dates. How can we improve the way we get along?

m-525.translation: Why do you watch such weird, out-there stuff every day? Watch something normal—your brain's gonna short-circuit. Hurry up and switch to something healthier.

m-530.translation: Avoid all-black suits—they look too formal—and skip the jeans.

m-524.translation: I remember you saying just last week that you're socially anxious—what a turnaround!

m-528.translation: Fishy, rank, lecherous, gamey, greasy—the whole toxic package.

errors.note: “色”指颜色/色泽（与腥、骚、膻、油并列的感官属性），译成“lecherous”（好色的）是误译，改变了原意。
“五毒俱全”是成语，指各种坏习性/坏事样样俱全，并非字面“有毒”，译文按字面译成“toxic package”偏离原意。

m-529.translation: Born with a natural gift for absurdity—seeing this straight-up crashed my brain.

errors.span: Born with a natural gift for absurdity
errors.note: “天生抽象圣体”是网络梗，指人本身自带荒诞/抽象气质，译成“gift for absurdity”把“圣体”（体质/本体）误译成“天赋”，意思有偏差。
“大脑宕机”译得偏生硬直译，口语字幕中“my brain just crashed/froze”更自然，但可理解。

m-531.translation: Fine, I'll deal with these paid troll comments once I'm back in China.

m-534.translation: Oh man, why didn't you say that sooner? I gotta go grab the tickets!

m-533.translation: But doesn't anyone else think the word "annoying" is also super annoying? (I'm out, I'm out—I'm such a word-illiterate)

errors.note: “丈育”是网络用语（“文盲”的谐音梗），译成“word-illiterate”生硬且不自然，未能传达原文的幽默口语感。

m-535.translation: But I think it's really sacred—every photo is a memory.

m-536.translation: I already felt awful, and laughing just made my stomach hurt even more.

errors.note: 原文“肚子更痛”指因笑而腹部（肚子）更痛，译文用“stomach”偏向胃部，且“made my stomach hurt”暗示引发胃痛，与“本来难受、笑得更痛”的语境有偏差。

m-532.translation: The 100,000 Memes series features the "read it, reply nonsense" memes that show off some top-tier mental stability.

errors.note: “十万个梗库”是系列名称，直译为“100,000 Memes”会误导观众以为真有十万个梗，应作为专名处理或意译。
“已读乱回”是网络梗，译文生硬直译，不像自然的字幕口语表达。

errors.span: that show off some top-tier mental stability
errors.note: “精神状态良好”在此是反讽用法，译文“top-tier mental stability”丢失了反讽语气，意思出现偏差。

m-538.translation: So what? Who cares? Watch it or don't, I couldn't care less.

m-539.translation: So what if I watch it? I'll even use your membership to watch. Love yourself, see you every day.

errors.note: “爱你老己”是网络谐音/昵称式说法（“爱你自己”的俏皮变体），译成“Love yourself”丢失了俏皮语气，且“老己”这一称呼未体现，属误译。
“天天见”在此更像口语化收尾/口头禅，直译为“see you every day”略显生硬，但意思基本可接受。

m-542.translation: Forget it—with that IQ, you might as well give up gaming.

m-543.translation: Hope to see you and Jia Ling perform a sketch on next year's Spring Festival Gala!

m-544.translation: I rushed it this time—should've saved it for the New Year's party performance.

m-541.translation: Why do you watch such crazy stuff every day? Watch something normal—it's messing with my whole worldview.

errors.span: it's messing with my whole worldview
errors.note: 原文“三观都要被刷新了”是说话人自己三观被刷新，译文用“my whole worldview”基本对应，但“messing with”偏“干扰/搞乱”，与“刷新”语义略有偏差。

m-546.translation: I'll send you a screenshot so you can see how it turned out—guaranteed to have you laughing your head off hahaha

errors.span: That performance was absolutely maxed out.
errors.note: “maxed out”多指资源/额度用尽，用来形容“表现力拉满”生硬不自然，口语字幕中宜用更地道的表达。

m-717.translation: My mom asked me why there's red stuff on my white T-shirt.

errors.note: “乐子的草稿箱”是平台功能名（草稿箱），译文把“乐子”当作人名并大写，误将功能名处理成所有格人名，造成专名/术语错误。
原文“在乐子的草稿箱”指在某平台的草稿箱中，译文理解为“在乐子这个人的草稿箱里”，语义偏差明显。

errors.note: “抽象”在此处是网络口语，指难以理解、莫名其妙，译成“weird”略有偏差，但整体可接受。

errors.span: I'll be laughing at this scene for a whole year

errors.note: “Who Cares”作为作品/口号名被译成普通短语，未加书名号或保留专名标记，专名处理不够规范。
“three-piece combo”偏生硬，字幕口语中更自然说法如“three-piece set/the whole three-piece routine”，但不影响理解。

errors.note: 原文“你已急哭”指对方（听者）已经急得哭了，译文说成“你快要哭了”，时态和状态都不对，且“from stress”是额外添加的原因。

“验牌”是网络流行梗（查验/验证牌面），直译为“verify the cards”丢失了梗的含义，观众难以理解。

m-853.translation: I can't even — this Frankenfood is something else.

errors.note: “家人们”是网络直播/短视频中称呼观众的口语化称呼，译为“guys”丢失了这层亲切的称呼意味，属于漏译。
“救命啊”是夸张的呼救语气，译文“Help”偏平淡，未体现原文的夸张口语感。

m-857.translation: Get your snacks and blanket ready—enjoy a great weekend!

m-855.translation: You've mastered the invincible move, huh? You can probably hard CC hst and the opponent just GG's right away.

errors.note: hst 是游戏/直播语境中的专有名词（可能是玩家名或缩写），保留原样可以，但若原文指特定对象，最好确认大小写或写法一致；此处不算硬错。
“硬控”译为 hard CC 属游戏术语，基本可接受，但“硬控hst”在中文里更像“硬控住 hst”，英文缺了宾语标记，读起来略生硬。

errors.span: the opponent just GG's right away
errors.note: “GG's”作动词用虽在游戏口语中可见，但字幕里略显别扭，且“对面直接GG”更自然可译为“the opponent just GG's”或“the enemy just gives up”；此处不算误译。

m-861.translation: It's nutritious and cleaner than takeout.

m-860.translation: I can't take it—that reply was way too cold.

m-858.translation: My partner suddenly said they wanted to break up with me—turns out they were just joking.

m-859.translation: Can you carry me to win this round?

m-862.translation: You can download apps like Keep or Nike Training Club and follow along with the workouts.

m-864.translation: Take it seriously—youth's gone for good, but the memories remain.

m-863.translation: Xiao Yang Ge is totally uninhibited when filming his videos, but he was nervous as hell when he went up to accept his award.

m-866.translation: Please, don't put this on the test.

m-868.translation: I had three servings of stinky tofu today.

m-871.translation: The moment you get caught sneaking a look at your crush in class

m-870.translation: Tried to trim the cat's fur and it ended up square.

m-865.translation: So what? That's just my kind of thing.

errors.span: That's just my kind of thing.
errors.note: “my kind of thing”偏书面/生硬，口语字幕里更自然的是“that's my thing”或“I just love it”，语气不够贴近原文的随意口吻。

m-867.translation: I think there's already a trailer out—I even came across a promo video for her movie.

m-869.translation: Damn, I'm done—my legs don't even feel like mine anymore.

m-872.translation: These movies deliver both stunning visuals and real depth—they'll leave you seeing reality in a whole new way.

m-873.translation: The most important thing is to look like a teacher. Business casual is recommended—avoid anything too flashy.

m-875.translation: The game's about to drop a new version.

m-874.translation: The delivery guy dropped my milk tea.

m-876.translation: The Double Eleven flash sale payment page keeps freezing.

m-879.translation: I suggest saving a few well-written reports from your colleagues as reference—you'll get the hang of it soon enough.

m-877.translation: Why didn't you say so earlier? I thought I just wasn't trying hard enough.

m-878.translation: 666, I've shipped them so hard I got an ingrown toenail!

errors.note: “磕”指磕CP/被甜到，译文用“shipped them”把“磕”误解为“撮合/送CP”，且“so hard”是增译，改变了原意。
中文网络用语“六百六十六”表赞叹，直译为数字“666”在英文中虽可理解，但语气和口语感偏生硬。

m-881.translation: I'm preparing for the teacher certification exam soon—any efficient study tips you can share?

m-880.translation: That kind of behavior is honestly pretty bizarre—if I'd been there, I'd have been so awkward.

errors.note: “尴尬得很”指说话人自己会感到尴尬（I'd have felt so awkward），译文“I'd have been so awkward”意为“我会显得很笨拙/别扭”，把内心感受误译成了人的特质。

m-883.translation: My roommate left the dishes unwashed again—they've been piling up for a week.

m-886.translation: I'm under no obligation to tell you!

m-889.translation: Hahaha I can't, I'm so jealous of that hair volume

errors.note: “我不行了”是网络口语，表示被逗得受不了/笑到不行，直译成“I can't”在英语字幕里略显生硬，不够口语化。

m-885.translation: It's so absurd I literally fell apart on the spot.

errors.span: literally fell apart on the spot
errors.note: “原地裂开”是网络夸张语，表示崩溃/受不了，并非真的身体“裂开”；直译成 fell apart 会让英文观众误以为是身体或精神真的解体，意思有明显偏差。
“抽象”在此是网络用语，指离谱、难以理解，译作 absurd 基本可接受，但略偏“荒谬”，未完全传达“太抽象”的调侃语气。

m-888.translation: Among mainstream brands, the Ecovacs T10 is well-rounded across the board, the Roborock G10 focuses on mopping, and Xiaomi offers the best value for money.

m-882.translation: So when people say you're 'yiji jiku'—'already in hardship'—they actually mean 'yiji jiku'—'already crying from anxiety.' Last time someone mocked me like that, I just shot back, 'Bounce it right back at you!'

errors.span: So when people say you're 'yiji jiku'—'already in hardship'—they actually mean 'yiji jiku'—'already crying from anxiety.'
errors.note: 原文“原来别人说你已疾苦是你已急哭的意思”是解释谐音梗（“已疾苦”听起来像“已急哭”），译文把两个拼音都写成相同的 'yiji jiku'，丢失了“已疾苦”与“已急哭”的谐音对应关系，观众无法理解笑点。

errors.span: Bounce it right back at you!
errors.note: “反弹”是网络用语，指把嘲讽/恶意原样弹回对方；译成 'Bounce it right back at you!' 偏生硬、像直译，口语字幕中不够自然。

m-887.translation: I'm done for—this time I'm seriously stuffed to death.

errors.note: “我不行了”在此是口语化的“我吃不下了/受不了了”，译成“I'm done for”意为“我完蛋了/要死了”，意思明显偏差。
“撑死”是夸张口语，直译“stuffed to death”生硬不自然，英语口语常说“I'm gonna explode”或“I'm so stuffed”。

m-890.translation: I recommend using the Weiguang app to watch movies together, plus couple-exclusive apps like Love Diary.

errors.note: “微光”作为应用名通常音译为“Weiguang”可以接受，但若该应用有官方英文名（如“Vlight”），应使用官方名称。
“恋爱记”是应用专名，译为“Love Diary”属于意译；若该应用有官方英文名，应保持一致，否则可能让观众难以对应到具体应用。

m-893.translation: When I'm at a loss for words, I just start slapping labels on people.

m-895.translation: The key is to survey everyone's interests and preferences in advance, and arrange some icebreaker games to boost interaction.

m-891.translation: Help me clear out my Double Eleven shopping cart.

m-896.translation: I need to check the cards. We have to replay it in slow motion.

m-892.translation: The Qing Dynasty's been gone for ages, and you're still pulling this pointless formality crap.

m-897.translation: I came up with a prank—fake jumping off a building.

m-898.translation: Hey, quit yapping. Wait till I'm back in the country and I'll handle it.

m-894.translation: The 'read but reply nonsense' meme has been around for ages. This video isn't even interesting or popular, yet it suddenly popped up on the trending list. I'm honestly speechless.

errors.note: 直译生硬，不像自然的英文网络用语，可改为更口语化的表达
原文“之前就有了”仅表示早已存在，'for ages' 夸大了时间跨度
“无语”在此是无奈/吐槽语气，'speechless' 偏“震惊到说不出话”，语气略有偏差

m-899.translation: The mentor suddenly sent this message in the group chat.

m-901.translation: Isn't it enough that I can understand it myself?

m-902.translation: Bro, I lost my phone and I need to log into WeChat ASAP—do you know what my WeChat password is?

m-903.translation: The cafeteria lady gave me exactly 666 grams of rice.

errors.note: 原文只说“打了666克”，并未强调“正好/恰好”，exactly 属于轻微增译，改变了语气。

m-904.translation: I just watched the Liaoning Spring Festival Gala yesterday.

errors.note: “just”与“yesterday”语义重复且时态搭配不自然，口语字幕中略显别扭。

m-900.translation: So it was a meme all along. All I knew was that serious look on my face when I wanted to check the cards.

errors.note: 原文“我要验牌那严肃样”指说话人自己验牌时的严肃样子，但译文“on my face”把“我的脸”加了进去，改变了主语/指代，意思有偏差。

errors.span: when I wanted to check the cards
errors.note: “要验牌”更接近“about to check the cards / was going to check the cards”，译成“wanted to”略微改变了语气。

m-907.translation: The dance move you're copying is actually a spoof version.

m-906.translation: Please, I'm begging them not to come—they're so loud, so annoying, and just a total headache.

m-908.translation: As a dad, I have to stay up late researching this meme—just so I don't fall behind my kid.

m-909.translation: You think that's funny? Why won't the prophet give me a bird?

m-910.translation: I told my roommate I was starving, and she just went, "Sure, sure."

m-913.translation: I want to give the living room a new look. What decorating styles are popular these days?

m-905.translation: Ji Hongxing, coffin, ancestor, my blade and shield, Hajimi, Milk Dragon—this is a top-tier account!

errors.note: “季洪行”疑似人名或专有名词，音译成“Ji Hongxing”可能不当，且与原文语境（棺材、老祖等）不符，需核实是否为特定名称。
“老祖”直译为“ancestor”生硬，字幕口语中常指“老祖宗/老前辈”，此处不够自然。
“刀盾”译为“blade and shield”偏直译，若指游戏装备/技能名，术语可能不准确。
“哈基米”为网络流行语/专名，音译“Hajimi”可接受，但需与既有译名一致。
“奶龙”为特定IP/角色名，直译“Milk Dragon”可能不符合官方译名。

m-912.translation: I can't take it anymore, baby. Let's watch it tomorrow.

m-911.translation: I've been wanting to learn skateboarding lately, but I'm always scared of falling. Any tips or safety precautions a beginner should know about?

m-914.translation: For sure, bro. This story is way too wild.

m-915.translation: Can you copy my homework for me?

errors.note: “抄作业”指借来照抄别人的作业，译文却变成让别人替自己抄/代写作业，意思完全相反。

m-916.translation: Just suck it up. Isn't that how it is for all of us wage slaves?

m-918.translation: Don't worry, I'll take it seriously this time.

m-920.translation: I snuck five phones into class and took turns gaming on them.

m-917.translation: The show I was binge-watching suddenly went downhill at the end.

errors.note: “烂尾”指剧集结尾质量崩坏、令人失望，而“went downhill at the end”只表示结尾变差，未体现“烂尾”所含的结局糟糕、虎头蛇尾之意，语义有偏差。

m-922.translation: If you don't hand in this homework, I'm telling the teacher.

m-921.translation: Ran three marathons, my legs are like jelly.

errors.span: Ran three marathons, my legs are like jelly.
errors.note: 两个独立分句仅用逗号连接，构成逗号粘连（comma splice），应改为 "I ran three marathons, and my legs are like jelly" 或分号连接。

m-919.translation: Eating while hitting you with a nostalgia trip—that's like rubbing salt in the wound and then asking if it's salty enough. Unbelievable.

errors.span: hitting you with a nostalgia trip
errors.note: “回忆杀”指突然涌来的怀旧情绪，用“hitting you with”略显生硬，且“you”添加了原文没有的受话对象。
“绝了”是口语化的感叹，译作“Unbelievable”语气偏书面/直译，字幕口语感稍弱。

m-923.translation: I want to set up a smart home, but I've heard that devices from different brands might not be compatible. How should I choose so I can avoid that problem?

m-925.translation: I posted a ton of dumb jokes on my Moments.

m-924.translation: Wait till I get back home and handle this—then we'll see who comes crawling to whom.

m-927.translation: I followed an influencer's tutorial to plan a surprise for my girlfriend, and she got mad.

m-926.translation: Did the boss say how late we're working overtime?

m-930.translation: I thought it was a monologue, but it turned out to be a voiceover.

m-931.translation: Are you really in any shape to keep studying?

m-929.translation: Your crush vs. your bestie—who's better looking?

errors.note: “你心动”指“让你心动的人”，译文误译为“your crush”（你暗恋的人），意思完全不同，观众会得到错误信息。

m-932.translation: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? You really know how to keep a secret!

m-933.translation: Because you've gone from being the star of the campus to just a nobody.

m-934.translation: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? I already missed the launch.

m-935.translation: What do I do when my boss is gaslighting me and I still have to work overtime?

m-937.translation: I can't even—that was absolutely stunning.

m-936.translation: Ever heard of the Shanghai big-shot flex?

errors.note: “沪爷”是网络俚语，指上海本地人（常带调侃/自嘲意味），译成“big-shot”（大人物）改变了含义，暗示有钱有势的人，而非本地人。
“冲击”在此语境中更接近“冲击/来袭/现象”的意思，而非“炫耀”；“flex”偏向炫耀，语气略有偏差。

m-939.translation: I've been working for two years and want to switch jobs, but I keep getting asked "why are you leaving?" in interviews. What's the best way to answer that?

m-938.translation: Damn, why didn't you say that earlier? I'm already seeing little people dancing.

errors.span: Damn, why didn't you say that earlier?
errors.note: “Damn” 添加了原文没有的脏话语气，原文“我去”更接近温和的惊讶/懊恼，语气略强。

errors.span: I'm already seeing little people dancing.
errors.note: “little people” 在英语中可能指侏儒，容易引起歧义；此处指幻觉中的小人，措辞不够自然。

m-940.translation: Emma, I can't even—she's breathtakingly beautiful.

errors.note: “艾玛”是感叹词（相当于“哎呀/天哪”），不是人名 Emma，误作人名会误导观众。
“我不行了”在此是“受不了/招架不住”的感叹，译成网络化的“I can't even”语气偏轻佻，与“美到窒息”的强烈赞叹略不搭。

m-944.translation: Why did you steal my kill?

m-943.translation: Take it seriously, okay? And don't forget to bring a gift.

m-941.translation: So what? Who cares? These two together are absolutely perfect—the comedic effect is off the charts.

errors.note: “谁理你”更接近“who cares about you / who's paying attention to you”，译成泛泛的“Who cares?”略弱化了指向对方的语气，但整体意思仍可理解。

m-945.translation: With this budget, I'd go with a Wi-Fi 6 router—better signal coverage and stability.

m-942.translation: The blogger shared some funny campus content—honestly, using that thing of yours really wouldn't work for me. This meme is way too real.

errors.span: 你那根我用确实不太合适
errors.note: “你那根”被译成“that thing of yours”，丢失了原文中“那根”这一具体指代（暗示某根状物/某物），且“我用”被译成“using ... for me”，把“我用（你的那根）”的主客体关系模糊化，意思有明显偏差。

errors.span: using that thing of yours really wouldn't work for me
errors.note: “wouldn't work for me”偏书面/生硬，作为字幕口语不够自然，且“for me”易被理解为“对我来说”，与原意“我用不合适”略有出入。

errors.span: This meme is way too real
errors.note: “这个梗过于真实”译成“This meme is way too real”尚可，但“梗”在此语境更接近“joke/bit”，用“meme”略偏，属轻微风格问题。

m-949.translation: Why does my video get throttled the moment I post it?

m-946.translation: We can agree to meet up once a month to keep things fresh.

m-947.translation: I want to start an emo vent group for fangirls—we can talk about our idols or just go crazy. Girls born after 2000 only.

errors.note: “00后”指2000年代出生的人，译成“born after 2000”会排除2000年出生的人，范围有偏差。
原文“追星”是追星行为，译文用“fangirls”把重点放在粉丝身份上，略有偏移。

m-948.translation: I watched that video on the homepage where the celebrity claimed she's a size 36.5 and then got caught out—I'm dying laughing.

errors.note: 中文“36码半”指中国/欧洲鞋码36.5，英文里应说“size 36.5 (EU)”或“a 36.5”，直接写“a size 36.5”在英文语境下会被理解为英美尺码，属尺码体系误译。
“露馅”指谎言/说法被揭穿，译文“got caught out”偏“被抓到/出丑”，语义略有偏移，但大意可理解。

m-950.translation: Crying cat meme.jpg — being a misheard-lyrics person is just too hard

errors.note: “空耳人”指喜欢/擅长把歌词听错成谐音梗的人，译成“misheard-lyrics person”生硬且语义偏移，未能传达“空耳”这一网络梗的含义。
“太难了”是网络口语感叹，译为“is just too hard”略显直译生硬，不够口语化。
